correctness.rationale: An independent enumeration partitioned all 2^15 labeled six-vertex tournaments into exactly 56 S6-orbits. For each canonical representative it rebuilt the out-neighborhood complex, searched vertex-order face matchings, and independently checked acyclicity of the reversed matched Hasse edges. Every class admitted a matching with no critical cells above dimension one and with the number of critical vertices equal to the number of connected components. The resulting homotopy distribution was exactly 34 point, 11 S1, 4 wedge_2 S1, 2 wedge_3 S1, 1 wedge_4 S1, 3 two-points, and 1 S1 disjoint point; the unique beta1=4 class had canonical mask 1332, orbit 240, automorphism group order 3, and outdegree sequence (3,3,3,2,2,2).
risks: The discrete-Morse certificates prove these finite homotopy types; no claim is made that the same list exhausts larger tournament orders.
